items.name: David Guetta
items.bio: David Guetta, born Pierre David Guetta, is a French DJ and music producer from Paris. His representative works include "Titanium", "When Love Takes Over" and "Play Hard" in collaboration with Sia. He has won a Grammy Award for Best Remixed Recording, and is the founder of the label What A Music. He regularly headlines major music festivals such as Tomorrowland and Ultra, holds a residency at Ushuaïa Ibiza, and is one of the best-selling dance music artists in the world.

items.name: Kygo
items.bio: Kygo (Kyrre Gørvell-Dahll) is a Norwegian DJ and producer from Bergen, pioneer of tropical house. His tracks Firestone, Stole the Show, and Higher Love became global anthems. First DJ to hit one billion Spotify streams, he headlines major festivals worldwide.

items.name: Skrillex
items.bio: Skrillex (Sonny John Moore) is an American DJ and producer from Los Angeles, Grammy-winning pioneer of dubstep and electronic music. His EP Scary Monsters and Nice Sprites revolutionized bass music in 2010. Collaborations with major artists and his OWSLA label continue to shape electronic music.

items.name: Fred again..
items.bio: Fred again.., born Frederick John Philip Gibson, is a British producer from London. His Actual Life album series blends UK dance with emotional sampling. Collaborations include work with Brian Eno and headlining Coachella. Productions span garage, house, and ambient. Grammy winner for dance production. His live shows incorporate laptop production.

items.name: Illenium
items.bio: Nicholas Miller, known as Illenium, is an American DJ and producer. Known for emotional, melodic bass music. Hits include 'Crawl Outta Love' and 'Good Things Fall Apart'. Grammy-nominated for 'Fallen Embers' album.

items.name: Charlotte de Witte
items.bio: Charlotte de Witte is a Belgian techno DJ and producer from Ghent, a leading figure in modern techno. Starting in Ghent's underground clubs under the alias Raving George, she founded her KNTXT label in 2019. Her remix of The Age of Love with fiancé Enrico Sangiuliano topped charts and went gold. Ranked #9 in DJ Mag's Top 100 (2025), she hosts all-night KNTXT events at 23,000-capacity Flanders Expo and released her debut album in 2025.

items.name: Porter Robinson
items.bio:
Porter Weston Robinson (born July 15, 1992) is an American DJ, singer, songwriter, and record producer. Born in Atlanta, Georgia, and raised in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, Robinson began producing electronic music during his adolescence. He signed to Skrillex's record label OWSLA at the age of 18 and released the extended play Spitfire in 2011. He appeared on Billboard's 21 Under 21 list in 2012.
Robinson's debut studio album, Worlds, was released in 2014 and peaked at number one on Billboard's Top Dance/Electronic Albums. He won the 2015 MTVU Artist of the Year and made DJ Mag's Top 100 DJs list for seven consecutive years. The album was critically acclaimed and is considered to be a major influence on the broader sound of EDM following its release. At the inaugural Electronic Music Awards in 2017, he was nominated for Single of the Year and Live Act of the Year, both with Madeon, for the single "Shelter" and the Shelter Live Tour, respectively. He began producing music under the alias Virtual Self in 2017, releasing a self-titled EP the same year. "Ghost Voices", released under the Virtual Self alias in 2017, earned Robinson a nomination for the Grammy Award for Best Dance Recording.
Robinson released his second studio album Nurture in 2021, which debuted atop Billboard's Top Dance/Electronic Albums and earned him widespread acclaim. Nurture was included on several year-end lists, including topping The Fader's list of the "50 Best Albums of 2021". His third album Smile! :D was released in 2024, supported by a world tour spanning over 70 shows between 2024 and 2025.

items.name: Gryffin
items.bio: Gryffin, real name Dan Griffith, is an American DJ, record producer and musician. He gained recognition for remixing well-known songs such as Tove Lo's "Talking Body", Maroon 5's "Animals", and Years & Years' "Desire". He released his debut single "Heading..." on January 22, 2016, focusing on melodic electronic music styles.

items.name: Anyma
items.bio: Anyma (Matteo Milleri) is an Italian DJ and producer, one half of the acclaimed duo Tale of Us alongside Carmine Conte. His solo project explores melodic techno with cinematic, immersive productions. Co-founder of the Afterlife label, his innovative live shows combine cutting-edge visual technology with emotional, atmospheric music. Headline performances at Coachella, Tomorrowland, and his immersive Sphere residency in Las Vegas showcase his vision for the future of electronic music.

items.name: John Summit
items.bio: John Summit is an American DJ and producer from Chicago. Known for tech house hits like 'Deep End' and 'La Danza'. One of the breakout stars of 2021, now headlining major festivals. Founded Experts Only label.

items.name: SLANDER
items.bio: SLANDER is an American DJ and music production duo from Los Angeles, consisting of Derek Anderson and Scott Land, formed in 2010. As a musically diverse electronic act headlining major festivals, they produce music spanning multiple electronic genres, with notable tracks including "Love Again", "Nuclear Bonds", "Love is Gone", and their signature style known as "Heaven Trap".

items.name: Subtronics
items.bio: Subtronics (Jesse Kardon) is an American dubstep producer from Philadelphia, known for his heavy, technically intricate bass music. His Cyclops Army fanbase and festival headline slots have made him one of dubstep's biggest current names.

items.name: Martin Garrix
items.bio: Martin Garrix, born Martijn Garritsen, is a Dutch DJ and producer from Amstelveen. His track Animals became a global phenomenon. Founded STMPD Records. Ranked number one DJ by DJ Mag multiple times. Regular headline performances at Tomorrowland, Ultra, and major festivals. His sound shaped future rave.
